title: How to Fix the System Service Exception Stop Code in Windows 10? - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Encountering the System Service Exception stop code in Windows 10 can be frustrating, especially since it often leads to a blue screen error. This type of error is commonly known as a BSOD (Blue Screen of Death). In this guide, we’ll walk you through how to fix the System Service Exception error in Windows 10 by identifying its causes and applying practical solutions. With a step-by-step approach, you’ll learn how to troubleshoot System Service Exceptions and ensure your system stays stable.

Table of Content

  • What is The BSOD System Service Exception Error on Windows?
  • Fix the Stop Code System Service Exception in Windows 10 (7 Solutions)
    • Method 1: Fix the Stop Code Error by Updating the Windows
    • Method 2: Fix System Service Exception Error by Updating Drivers
    • Method 3: Fix Corrupted Files for Stop Code Error
    • Method 4: Fix System Service Exception Error by Scanning All Files & Drivers
    • Method 5: Fix Service Exception Stop Code by Removing the Latest Apps
    • Method 6: Reset Windows to Fix SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION Error
    • Method 7: Resolve Stop Code Error by Memory Diagnostic Tool

What is The BSOD System Service Exception Error on Windows?

The BSOD Stop Code system service exception on Windows can occur during the system booting period. In this particular process, there is no proper reason is mentioned. In this case, the Windows Blue Screen Death (BSOD) occurred & the device went to the immediate rebooting that caused temporary relief.

However, within that short temporary relief, you have to perform a series of operations to stop the complete process. This is the problem that is marked as the most Common Windows Error that can prompt for any kind of reason. Some of the reasons are the following.

  • A long Pending Windows Update.
  • Malware or Virus infection to the Windows.
  • Outdated Driver of Windows OS.
  • Corrupted Disk Files or Drivers.
  • Any Memory or RAM-related software problem on Windows.

Fix the Stop Code System Service Exception in Windows 10 (7 Solutions)

With the given 7 Solutions, You can easily resolve the SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION Windows Stop Code, the following handful of methods need to be executed. We will start with the simple method to start Windows Update

Method 1: Fix the Stop Code Error by Updating the Windows

To Fix Stop code System service exception by updating Windows, You need to follow the given steps

Step 1: Open Windows Settings & go to the Update & Security option.

Step 2: After that, click on the Check For Updates option to install the Latest Windows Update.

Method 2: Fix System Service Exception Error by Updating Drivers

In The Second Solution, you need to update drivers to fix the stop code system service exception error, Follow the given steps carefully

Step 1: Right-click over the Start Icon & click on the Device Manager option.

Step 2: Click on each driver there & then, select the Update Driver option.

Step 3: After that, click on the Search Automatically For Driver option.

Method 3: Fix Corrupted Files for Stop Code Error

In The next solution, You need to fix Corrupted files to fix the stop code error on Windows

Step 1: Search for the Command Prompt in the Search Bar & open the application.

Step 2: Execute the following command. It will check the entire Driver & Disk if anything is being corrupted there or not.

Command: chkdsk C: /f

Method 4: Fix System Service Exception Error by Scanning All Files & Drivers

Here are the 2 easy steps to fix system service exception error in Windows

Step 1: Again, search for Command Prompt & open the service.

Step 2: Execute the following command. It will scan all the files & drivers of the system. Also, it will fix if anything causes the issue.

Command: sfc /scannow

Method 5: Fix Service Exception Stop Code by Removing the Latest Apps

In this solution, You will have to remove the latest programs to fix BSOD service exceptions stop code errors, and follow the given steps to fix them.

Step 1: Search for the Add or Remove Application on the Search Bar.

Step 2: After that, select the application that is recently installed. Now, click on the Uninstall to remove the app.

Method 6: Reset Windows to Fix SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION Error

Step 1: Open Settings & click on the Update & Security option.

Step 2: Under the Reset The PC option, click on the Get Started option.

Step 3: After that, click on the Keep My Files option.

Method 7: Resolve Stop Code Error by Memory Diagnostic Tool

Step 1: Search for the Memory Diagnostic Tool on the Search Bar.

Step 2: Then, click on the Restart Now Button to check & fix any problem related to the Memory of Windows.

Conclusion

The System Service Exception stop code can seem daunting at first, but with the right troubleshooting steps, you can resolve it and prevent future occurrences. By keeping your system updated, ensuring your drivers are compatible, and addressing potential software conflicts, you can effectively fix System Service Exception in Windows 10. A well-maintained system ensures fewer disruptions from BSOD System Service Exception errors, providing you with a smoother computing experience.
